extracted.name: Creamy Jalapeño Sauce
extracted.description: This is a great zippy, spicy, creamy sauce for anything Mexican. It's not overly spicy, it's more a fresh zing. Use for tacos, quesadillas, burritos and anything Mexican. Also great for dipping in veggie sticks or corn chips!Makes 1 cup, enough for 16 to 20 tacos, or dipping sauce for 3 - 4 burritos.
ingredient_lines: 1/3 cup pickled jalapeños ((my default - I like the tanginess and convenience))
3 - 4 tbsp roughly chopped fresh jalapeños (, white membrane and seeds removed (terrific fresh jalapeño flavour))
1/3 cup whole-egg mayonnaise or kewpie (, or more sour cream (Note 2))
1/3 cup tightly packed coriander/cilantro leaves ((just rip a handful of leaves off the stems, some stems is fine))
1/4 tsp cooking salt / kosher salt ((use a little extra if using fresh jalapeños))
instruction_lines: Blitz and stir - Put everything EXCEPT the sour cream in a jug. Blitz using a stick blender until it's completely smooth. Then stir in the sour cream. (Note 3) Taste and add more salt or lime juice, if needed.
